notes: Screen recording. The extension can now record the screen, a window or a tab - press Record the screen in the popup. The file saves to Downloads by itself and can go to Drive with the same Click Me link a screenshot uses. Computer sound is on by default and your voice is off; both together are blended into one track. Chrome's own Stop sharing bar stops it as well as the page's own button, the toolbar shows REC while it runs, and Update now will not close a recording without asking. No new permission: Chrome's share picker is the permission.
